input: After rushed deliveries, accounting keeps finding items with on-hand quantity below zero; the system should refuse to validate such transfers, except for the spare-parts product category that is only counted at month end.

output.normalized_en: The system must prevent the validation of stock transfers that involve products with a negative on-hand quantity. An exception is made for products belonging to the spare-parts product category, which are counted at month end and can be processed despite negative inventory.
